create_client_openai: create an OpenAI client with base_url pointing to the HuggingFace router and an HF_TOKEN api_key
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call using client.chat.completions.create with a model and user messages
build_llm_request_together: build a conversational LLM request to the Together AI endpoint via the HuggingFace router
test_chat_completion_response: test the chat completion response by accessing completion.choices[0].message
summarize_completion_output: summarize the LLM completion output printed from the response object
